- Port scan: the "Web" category is replaced by "All", which tests ports 0 to 65535
- Ping: 0 packets now means an unlimited ping (until stopped); the interval (1 s) and size are no longer adjustable
- Traceroute: the maximum number of hops is no longer adjustable
- Network audit: the letter in front of the score is gone, only the score out of 100 remains
- Wi-Fi: UPnP and Bonjour scanners removed
- Unknown trackers: filter by device type (AirTag, AirPods, Find My accessory, Apple device, Google tag, Galaxy SmartTag, Tile)
- Unknown trackers: AirPods and AirTags are identified from the model read on the device
- SDR: switching tab, band or frequency stops the current search and selects the new choice
- Weather satellites (Meteor-M): the demodulator no longer mistakes noise or a spurious carrier for a QPSK signal, and finds the satellite even with a spurious carrier in the band
- Updates: the app looks for new versions on the renamed All-Radio-Tools repository
